person.name: Dr. Lior Tabansky
person.tagline: In person · With you present · You control your credentials
person.taglineShort: In person · You control your credentials

contact.heading: Start with a private conversation.
contact.reassurance: Dr. Tabansky replies personally. The first conversation is free and commits you to nothing.

price.lead: One first step, then the protection that fits your household. Each price is fixed and agreed in writing before work begins.
price.method: Every engagement is carried out by Dr. Lior Tabansky in person, at your home or office, with you present and in control of your credentials. Hardening is Toza's own method, developed from public guidance of government security agencies and security vendors.

assessment.name: Private Exposure Assessment
assessment.body: A senior check-up of your digital life: half a day in person with Dr. Tabansky, urgent first aid on the spot, and a written exposure summary you keep whether or not you continue.

price.credit: Counts in full toward your protection if you continue within {days} days.
price.creditShort: Counts in full toward your protection within {days} days.

shield.name: Personal Shield
shield.for: For one person. Your phone, computer, accounts and home network hardened around your risks.
items: Two security keys, configured and tested
A follow-up visit after about four weeks
Questions answered by WhatsApp or Signal for 60 days
shield.homeLine: Fixed and agreed in writing before any work, first step included.

two.name: Personal Shield for Two
two.for: For you and one other person.
items: Each person's phone, computer and accounts
Your home network · four security keys
Follow-up visit · 60 days of answered questions

inner.name: Inner Circle
inner.for: For a household of up to four.
items: Everyone's phones, computers and accounts, each kept private
Your home network · eight security keys
Follow-up visit · 60 days of answered questions · review visit at twelve months

price.underAll: The first step is included. If you authorize it, Dr. Tabansky coordinates with your lawyer or family office.
price.larger: Larger households, several residences or household staff: one fixed price, set out after the first step, from {price}.
price.care: After the 60 days: Annual Care for past clients, from {price} a year.

stages.heading: Three stages, one person.

assess.name: Assess
assess.line: Your threat model, your risks in order, and urgent first aid. Typically four hours.

harden.name: Harden
harden.line: Settings, accounts and recovery rebuilt around your risks. Security keys supplied and configured.

verify.name: Verify
verify.line: Changes tested and checked, and you are taught to use them. A private dated record of the work.

stages.method: Hardening is Toza's own method, developed from public guidance of government security agencies and security vendors.
